heading: INT. SYNERGY SOLUTIONS - CONFERENCE ROOM 12 - DAY

units.text: INT. SYNERGY SOLUTIONS - CONFERENCE ROOM 12 - DAY
Thanks for squeezing me in, Penelope.
units.name: DARIUS FEATHERSTONEHAUGH

units.text: Always. You have fifteen minutes.
units.name: PENELOPE ACHTERBERG-SOLOMON

units.text: I only need ten. I want to talk about a rebrand.
units.name: DARIUS FEATHERSTONEHAUGH

units.text: Of what?
units.name: PENELOPE ACHTERBERG-SOLOMON

units.text: Of the team.
units.name: DARIUS FEATHERSTONEHAUGH

units.text: We're a team of two.
units.name: PENELOPE ACHTERBERG-SOLOMON

units.text: That's the problem. We feel like a duo. I want us to feel like a movement.
units.name: DARIUS FEATHERSTONEHAUGH

units.text: A movement of two.
units.name: PENELOPE ACHTERBERG-SOLOMON

units.text: A movement that has not yet scaled.
units.name: DARIUS FEATHERSTONEHAUGH

units.text: Go on.
units.name: PENELOPE ACHTERBERG-SOLOMON

units.text: I propose we call ourselves the Alignment Pod.
units.name: DARIUS FEATHERSTONEHAUGH

units.text: The Alignment Pod.
units.name: PENELOPE ACHTERBERG-SOLOMON

units.text: With a mission statement. Draft: "To align what is misaligned, and to pod what is unpodded."
units.name: DARIUS FEATHERSTONEHAUGH

units.text: What does "pod" mean as a verb?
units.name: PENELOPE ACHTERBERG-SOLOMON

units.text: It means to gather in the spirit of synergy.
units.name: DARIUS FEATHERSTONEHAUGH

units.text: Darius, how long have you worked here?
units.name: PENELOPE ACHTERBERG-SOLOMON

units.text: Eleven years in March.
units.name: DARIUS FEATHERSTONEHAUGH

units.text: And in eleven years, you have never once had a new idea.
units.name: PENELOPE ACHTERBERG-SOLOMON

units.text: That is unkind.
units.name: DARIUS FEATHERSTONEHAUGH

units.text: It's also the reason I'm going to approve this.
units.name: PENELOPE ACHTERBERG-SOLOMON

units.text: You are?
units.name: DARIUS FEATHERSTONEHAUGH

units.text: On one condition. You are the only member of the Alignment Pod.
units.name: PENELOPE ACHTERBERG-SOLOMON

units.text: And you?
units.name: DARIUS FEATHERSTONEHAUGH

units.text: I am the Pod's supervisor, from a distance.
units.name: PENELOPE ACHTERBERG-SOLOMON

units.text: I'll take it.
units.name: DARIUS FEATHERSTONEHAUGH

units.text: Good. Your ten minutes are up.
units.name: PENELOPE ACHTERBERG-SOLOMON

units.text: Penelope, one last thing.
units.name: DARIUS FEATHERSTONEHAUGH

units.text: Yes?
units.name: PENELOPE ACHTERBERG-SOLOMON

units.text: The Pod will require a budget.
units.name: DARIUS FEATHERSTONEHAUGH

units.text: Of course it will.
units.name: PENELOPE ACHTERBERG-SOLOMON
